statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while NQ is closed for the weekend; Stress remains high because Hormuz restrictions and Friday's hawkish rate repricing leave reopening-gap risk unresolved.
recommendation: The published state remains low Tail with high headline and reopening-gap Stress; no live NQ price path is available to establish persistent one-way behavior.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while Hormuz and rate risks sustain Stress
body: NQ is closed for the weekend. Friday's Nasdaq fell 0.52% with negative breadth and semiconductor weakness, while most megacaps rose. Reuters reports that Hormuz restrictions remain in place and commodity-vessel traffic is below its recent average. This mixed backdrop supports high Stress without live evidence of persistent mean-reversion failure.
